statement: Let D(a,b) = b-a if a < b, and n-a+b if a > b, for 1 ≤ a,b ≤ n with a ≠ b. For 1 ≤ s ≤ n, let V(s) = (1 if s = rounds[0] else 0) + Σ_{i=0}^{L-2} Σ_{k=1}^{D(rounds[i],rounds[i+1])} [((rounds[i]-1+k) mod n)+1 = s], where [P] is 1 if P holds and 0 otherwise. Let M = max_{1 ≤ s ≤ n} V(s). Whenever the function returns a result r, r is exactly the strictly ascending list of all sectors s with 1 ≤ s ≤ n and V(s) = M: len(r) = |{s : 1 ≤ s ≤ n and V(s) = M}|, and for every j with 0 ≤ j < len(r), r[j] is the (j+1)-th smallest sector s with 1 ≤ s ≤ n and V(s) = M.
preconditions: 2 ≤ n ≤ 100; let L = len(rounds); 2 ≤ L ≤ 101; for every i with 0 ≤ i < L, 1 ≤ rounds[i] ≤ n; for every i with 0 ≤ i < L-1, rounds[i] ≠ rounds[i+1].

statement: The function returns a result r; it does not fail, overflow, access out of bounds, panic, or otherwise raise a runtime error.

statement: Let D(a,b) = b-a if a < b, and n-a+b if a > b, for 1 ≤ a,b ≤ n with a ≠ b. For 1 ≤ s ≤ n, let V(s) = (1 if s = rounds[0] else 0) + Σ_{i=0}^{L-2} Σ_{k=1}^{D(rounds[i],rounds[i+1])} [((rounds[i]-1+k) mod n)+1 = s], and let M = max_{1 ≤ s ≤ n} V(s). Whenever the function returns a result r, every most-visited sector occurs in r: for every s with 1 ≤ s ≤ n, if V(s) = M then there exists j with 0 ≤ j < len(r) and r[j] = s.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r is the strictly ascending list of the sectors visited by the whole marathon, which is the circular arc starting at rounds[0] and taking T one-step moves: r is the sorted list of the distinct values {((rounds[0]-1+t) mod n)+1 : 0 ≤ t ≤ T}.
preconditions: 2 ≤ n ≤ 100; let L = len(rounds); 2 ≤ L ≤ 101; for every i with 0 ≤ i < L, 1 ≤ rounds[i] ≤ n; for every i with 0 ≤ i < L-1, rounds[i] ≠ rounds[i+1]. Let D(a,b) = b-a if a < b, and n-a+b if a > b, for 1 ≤ a,b ≤ n with a ≠ b. Let T = Σ_{i=0}^{L-2} D(rounds[i],rounds[i+1]). Assume T ≤ n-1.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r is the list of all sectors in ascending order: r = [1, 2, ..., n].

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r: if T is even, then r is the one-element list [rounds[0]]; if T is odd, then r is the two-element list [1, 2].
preconditions: 2 ≤ n ≤ 100; let L = len(rounds); 2 ≤ L ≤ 101; for every i with 0 ≤ i < L, 1 ≤ rounds[i] ≤ n; for every i with 0 ≤ i < L-1, rounds[i] ≠ rounds[i+1]. statement: Whenever the function returns result r on (n,rounds) and result r' on (n,rounds_c), r' is exactly the strictly ascending list of the sector labels ρ_c(x) for x occurring in r.
preconditions: 2 ≤ n ≤ 100; let L = len(rounds); 2 ≤ L ≤ 101; for every i with 0 ≤ i < L, 1 ≤ rounds[i] ≤ n; for every i with 0 ≤ i < L-1, rounds[i] ≠ rounds[i+1]. Let c be an integer with 0 ≤ c < n, define ρ_c(s) = ((s-1+c) mod n)+1 for 1 ≤ s ≤ n, and let rounds_c be the length-L array with rounds_c[i] = ρ_c(rounds[i]).

statement: Let D(a,b) = b-a if a < b, and n-a+b if a > b, for 1 ≤ a,b ≤ n with a ≠ b. Whenever the function returns a result r, equal visit counts are treated equally: for every s,t with 1 ≤ s ≤ n and 1 ≤ t ≤ n, if V(s) = V(t), then s occurs in r if and only if t occurs in r.
